transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Friday, August 14. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Indian IT sector job market is changing: What can get you hired and at a premium. Experts believe that the era of broad-based recruitment and hefty pay hikes in the Indian IT sector is over. Companies are now tightening hiring at the entry level, while at the same time competing to get experienced professionals in select areas. 'Udhar nahi jaana': Auqib Nabi recalls how India call-up came as a surprise. That opportunity came when Nabi was added to India's squad as a replacement for injured fast bowler Jasprit Bumrah for the upcoming two-Test series against Sri Lanka, beginning in Sri Lanka on Saturday. JNU VC says her varsity a beggar, needs Venkateswara temple to raise funds. Draupadi First Feminist; JNU Historians Turned Facts Upside Down: VC Robot reaches 4,500-year-old sealed barrier inside Egypt's Great Pyramid. A robot explored a hidden passage within Egypt's Great Pyramid of Giza. It reached a sealed barrier which may be 4,500 years old. This discovery has renewed questions about the ancient monument's hidden contents. Researchers used modern technology to examine areas difficult for people to access. UP polls: How parties are vying for Dalit votes amid Mayawati's shrinking base. A notable evolution in Dalit politics is unfolding in Uttar Pradesh, marked by a decline in the Bahujan Samaj Party's dominance. The Bharatiya Janata Party and the Samajwadi Party are actively courting Dalit voters ahead of elections, and the Congress party is also working to regain its historic connections. Meanwhile, Chandrashekhar Azad is establishing a distinct political identity, foreshadowing a significant shift in the Dalit electoral landscape. Six dead, 2 missing after water, debris enter under-construction tunnel in U'khand. DEHRADUN: Six workers have died and two reported missing after a landslide caused a cavity to form in an under-construction THDC tunnel at Mayapur in Pipalkoti area of Chamoli district, causing a rush of water and debris to enter the tunnel on Thursday evening. 'No clear info': Nepal PM claims Indian territory, but 'loses' 210-year-old treaty papers. Nepal's foreign minister announced that the country might have misplaced the original Sugauli Treaty papers, which played a critical role in establishing its borders with British India after the Anglo-Nepalese War. This comes at a time when border disputes with India have intensified. The government plans to systematically assess numerous international agreements, seeking to amend or renew any that are no longer pertinent. SAD chief assailant a law graduate, ran snacks centre in Pune: Police. PUNE: The man accused of attacking Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) president and former Punjab deputy chief minister Sukhbir Singh Badal with a kirpan at Mata Sahib Devaji Gurdwara in Nanded on Thursday has deep roots in Pune city, police said. Deepwater Horizon damaged deep-sea corals; NOAA is now planting new colonies. In a groundbreaking initiative, scientists are working to revive deep-sea coral ecosystems that were harmed by an oil spill. Utilizing corals grown in laboratories along with advanced tools, they have successfully deployed these corals at great depths. This project focuses on rejuvenating delicate habitats in the Gulf of Mexico, with ongoing monitoring set to evaluate both the survival rates of the corals and the overall restoration of the ecosystem. Google co-founder's message for DeepMind staff after Demis Hassabis exits as CEO. Google co-founder Sergey Brin has been urging Google DeepMind staff to go all in on Gemini and catch up to the AI frontier, following a sweeping leadership overhaul that saw Demis Hassabis step aside as CEO. Koray Kavukcuoglu now runs day-to-day operations from Mountain View, with final say on major decisions. The reshuffle follows Gemini release delays, coding benchmark gaps against Anthropic and OpenAI, and high-profile exits including Jeff Dean. 'Time to move on,' says HC on Vijay Mallya's plea against recovery. Asks ED To Confirm If Recovery Claims Settled
